episodes.name: The Falcon and the D'ohman
episodes.overview: Homer befriends a new security guard at the plant; Marge daydreams about being a contestant on "Top Chef."

episodes.name: Bart Stops to Smell the Roosevelts
episodes.overview: When superintendent Chalmers is fired for taking Bart and his friends on an unauthorized field trip, the boys hold the school hostage until he is reinstated.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXII
episodes.overview: A boulder traps Homer's arm when he takes a drive through a canyon; a spider bite paralyzes Homer; Flanders becomes a vigilante by night; Bart and Milhouse travel to a distant planet to obtain an extract.

episodes.name: Replaceable You
episodes.overview: Lisa's science fair project is overshadowed by Bart's mechanical baby seal; Homer's new assistant ends up stealing his job.

episodes.name: The Food Wife
episodes.overview: Marge, Bart and Lisa start their own food blog and land a reservation at a popular restaurant; when Marge sends Homer to a cooking lab, he finds himself in a situation with law enforcement.

episodes.name: The Book Job
episodes.overview: Homer creates a team, including author Neil Gaiman, to write the next hit "tween" book; after receiving an advance copy of the work from his publisher, Homer learns there's more to the business than he imagined.

episodes.name: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
episodes.overview: The Simpsons host a party to promote Krusty's own brand of liquor; impressed with the party's sucess, Mr. Burns decides to promote Homer; Bart takes an interest in reading classic novels.

episodes.name: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
episodes.overview: After Krusty the Clown's show is canceled and his talent agency drops him, his very first agent, Annie, tries to craft his comeback.

episodes.name: Holidays of Future Passed
episodes.overview: Thirty years in the future, Bart, Lisa and their children spend the holidays at Marge and Homer's house.

episodes.name: Politically Inept, with Homer Simpson
episodes.overview: After a video of Homer ranting goes viral, he gets his own political talk show; Homer endorses rocker Ted Nugent for the Republican presidential nominee.

episodes.name: The D'oh-cial Network
episodes.overview: Lisa is called to trial after her online social networking site creates dysfunction in the community; Patty and Selma compete in a rowing event.

episodes.name: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
episodes.overview: Moe's bar rag explains that he started as a medieval tapestry a thousand years earlier; Bart tries to reconcile with Milhouse; the disappearance of Moe's bar rag makes him realize he has friends.

episodes.name: The Daughter Also Rises
episodes.overview: Marge and Lisa's plans for a mother-daughter Valentine's Day take a turn when Lisa falls head over heels for an intellectual romantic; Bart and Milhouse investigate Springfield Elementary's legends.

episodes.name: At Long Last Leave
episodes.overview: When the Simpsons are kicked out of Springfield, they join an off-the-grid community near by; Homer and Marge's former friends react badly when they try to sneak back into town.

episodes.name: Exit Through the Kwik-E-Mart
episodes.overview: When Bart decides to get back at Homer by becoming a graffiti artist, established street artists offer him a gallery show; a new health food store threatens to put Apu out of business.

episodes.name: How I Wet Your Mother
episodes.overview: When Homer's bed-wetting worsens, his family tries to infiltrate his dreams to find the source of the problem.

episodes.name: Them, Robot
episodes.overview: When Mr. Burn replaces most of the plant's employees with robots that end up turning on the community, the people he laid off must come to the rescue.

episodes.name: Beware My Cheating Bart
episodes.overview: Bart ends up in trouble with school bullies after Jimbo's girlfriend develops feelings for him; Homer buys a treadmill equipped with a TV.

episodes.name: A Totally Fun Thing That Bart Will Never Do Again
episodes.overview: When Bart gets his wish for a family vacation, he becomes determined to make it last forever.

episodes.name: The Spy Who Learned Me
episodes.overview: Marge and Homer go on a date, but Marge is embarrassed when Homer talks during the movie; when Homer gets hurt and can't work, he tries to learn how to be a better husband from a man he believes is a movie star.

episodes.name: Ned 'n Edna's Blend Agenda
episodes.overview: When Marge learns Ned and Edna got married, she offers to throw them a reception; Edna changes some rules to help Ned's kids become more socially acceptable.

episodes.name: Lisa Goes Gaga
episodes.overview: Lisa tries to make herself more popular by writing good things about herself on the school blog, but the plan backfires; Lisa helps Lady Gaga and learns the importance of being yourself.
